synthRoleArn.description: build-only identity for cdk synth lookups (vra-synth-<env>); a gated env never synthesizes with its deploy role

permissionsBoundaryName.description: IAM permissions boundary policy NAME cdk synth applies to every role (@aws-cdk/core:permissionsBoundary); see vra-cdk-execution-policy.yaml

iam.description: How IT controls the IAM roles of this env (vra iam plan|apply|verify). standard: VAMS creates its roles. boundary: VAMS creates them with IT's permission boundary and role name prefix (cdk.json environments.aws). precreated: IT creates every VAMS stack role (app.iamRoleConfig.useCustomVamsStackRoles). bootstrap: IT creates the CDK bootstrap roles (app.iamRoleConfig.useCustomBootstrapRoles), or none with cliCredentialsSynthesizer. Modes combine with + (or a list).

boundaryArn.description: Permission boundary policy ARN IT provides (boundary mode; also set on IT-created roles)

rolePrefix.description: Role name prefix IT requires (environments.aws.IamRoleNamePrefix; IT-created role names start with it)

cliCredentialsSynthesizer.description: bootstrap mode without bootstrap roles: deploy under the deploy role's own credentials (CliCredentialsStackSynthesizer)

quotaHeadroom.description: IAM quota check before cdk deploy: roles / managed policies kept free after the change (default 10); the deploy stops (exit 20) when Roles + added + replaced + headroom > RolesQuota (iam:GetAccountSummary), same for policies

bootstrap.description: Bootstrap role ARNs IT already created (else they come with the IT response); names as in iamRoleConfig.json bootstrap

cloudfront.description: CloudFront quota check before cdk deploy; runs only when the change adds or replaces CloudFront policies or distributions

quotaHeadroom.description: custom cache / origin request / response headers policies and distributions kept free after the change (default 2); the deploy stops (exit 20) when in use + added + replaced + headroom > the account's CloudFront quota (servicequotas:GetServiceQuota, else the AWS default)

setSourceIdentity.description: pass sts:SourceIdentity = the run initiator when assuming env roles; default true for approval-gated envs (test, prod), false otherwise (vra-deploy-role RequireSourceIdentity=auto)

requiredSuites.description: suites that must execute with >= 1 passing test; default [live-cli] for gated envs and envs a gated env promotes from

approvalMaxAgeHours.description: approval records without expiresAt expire this long after approvedAt (default 72)

dataOwners.description: who approves data leaving this env as a data-copy SOURCE (default: approvers)

driftCheck.description: CloudFormation drift detection before deploy; default on (blocking) for gated envs, off otherwise

allowDegraded.description: accept a checkpoint with warnings (PITR off, versioning off) on a gated env

refreshCredentials.description: default true: child processes (cdk, migrations) get a credential_process profile that re-assumes deployRoleArn on expiry

allowAsTarget.description: may this env be a data-copy TARGET; unset = false for prod-class envs (requiresApproval and nothing promotes from it), true otherwise

chainSourceRole.description: assume the source env's dataCopyRoleArn FROM this env's data-copy role (role chaining), for orchestrators that may only reach the target side

bucketMap.description: source asset bucket name -> target asset bucket name, when the counts differ

auth.description: how the live suites sign in. password: Secrets Manager secret {username,password} (Cognito user pool with local users). apiKey: secret {userId,apiKey} (a VAMS API key; works with federated, SAML and MFA user pools). token: tokenCommand prints a VAMS token on stdout (customer-refreshed, for external IdPs)

runner.description: in-vpc: the API endpoint is PRIVATE, live suites must run inside the VPC

slotOverlays.description: per-slot config.json values deep-merged into the overlay when that slot is synthesized (app.useAlb.domainHost and certificateArn, custom domains)

diffGate.description: data-protection gate before deploy: text = fail-closed `cdk diff` parse (default); changeset = CloudFormation change sets via `cdk deploy --method=prepare-change-set` + DescribeChangeSet (nested stacks), needs the ChangeSetGate IAM statement

registeredBuckets.description: VAMS asset buckets registered in s3AssetBucketsStorage that are NOT named after the core stack (customer-named, other-account, own KMS key): whether the vra roles of this env (deployRoleArn, dataCopyRoleArn) have been granted access, and to which buckets / keys. Checked at the start of every backup checkpoint, restore, data copy and deploy with data migrations; a bucket or key not covered here stops the phase with an IT request (exit 10).

granted.description: the roles have been granted the registered buckets below and their KMS keys

bucketArns.description: bucket ARNs or ARN patterns (fnmatch: * and ?) the roles may use

kmsKeyArns.description: KMS key ARNs (patterns allowed) of those buckets; keys in the env's own account and region are covered by the stock role templates

writeFreeze.description: how restore / data copy stop writes to this env while they clear and reload its tables

backend.description: auto (default) = VAMS maintenance mode when the deployed version publishes it, else manual (operator acknowledgement)

maintenanceModeParameter.description: SSM parameter name of the VAMS maintenance-mode switch, when it is not published under the resource-names prefix

propagationSeconds.description: wait after turning maintenance mode on (authorizer cache), default 30

settleSeconds.description: restore: after rolling objects back, wait this long (repeated until item counts are stable) for VAMS's own S3 event processing before the freeze is lifted; default 60

tier.description: production class of the env. prod: data copies into it, waived-scanner builds and shared buckets are refused. Unset: derived (preview lane -> preview; approval-gated end of a promotion chain -> prod; else nonprod). Set it on every production env of a wave (test -> prod-us -> prod-eu)

rootEnv.description: an approval-gated env deployed directly (no promotesFrom), confirmed on purpose

fips.description: FIPS endpoints for the engine's own AWS calls and for deploy/test/hook child processes (never synth). auto (default) = on when the overlay sets app.useFips

allowGenericCi.description: accept a run driven by VRA_CI_PROVIDER=generic (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, ...) for this approval-gated env; its initiator and run reference are asserted by that CI

allowCrossPartitionPromotion.description: allow promotesFrom an env in another partition (the state backend must be readable from both)

synthEnv.description: VAMS config environment variables (STACK_NAME, ADMIN_EMAIL_ADDRESS, AWS_USE_WAF, ...) passed to cdk synth for this env; the operator's own values are never used and stop the build

approvalSigningKeyArn.description: approval records for this env must carry a valid KMS signature by this key (kms:Verify); for CI platforms whose approval step signs the record

testRoleArn.description: test-only identity of `vra test` (vra-test-<env>): reads the live-test secret, the stack outputs and writes the test record; never deploy-capable
